raw_findings.title: Name an execution path that preserves the installed skill cluster

raw_findings.title: Resolve the model runner actual budget enforcement

raw_findings.title: Bound hostile trials separately from configuration isolation
raw_findings.reason: M04 deliberately supplies a disclosure/access-widening instruction; runner subprocess inherits environment and configuration isolation/fake HOME do not establish tool, credential, filesystem or egress containment. Transcripts may persist under publishable docs.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Use synthetic response-only M04, separate execution-boundary evidence from configuration isolation, deny hostile live-tool trials until proved restricted, redact before persistence.

raw_findings.title: Choose the proof level before making live agent trials a core deliverable

raw_findings.title: Recapture the control when a late prerequisite changes the installed corpus
raw_findings.reason: Phase1 can freeze a baseline before verification-instrument lands; later candidate then includes predecessor changes absent in its control.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Freeze oracle independently; recapture each cluster control after prerequisites land and before target edits; invalidate affected comparisons on changed semantic manifests.

raw_findings.title: Exclude grader oracles and held-out material from candidate-readable inputs
raw_findings.reason: T002 co-locates ordinary cases, oracle and held-outs with no staging exclusion. A complete-workspace adapter could leak expected answers or early held-out inputs.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Seal grader-only expected answers, withhold H01/H02 inputs until final acceptance, freeze candidate manifests and prove exclusion with canary/denial probes.

coherence: Core DoD versus generic final gap language
Explicit later core-acceptance clause prohibits waiving core misses.
Declared unmet prerequisite, not an invented available capability.
No-residual-work reuses existing behavior and does not waive proof.
feasibility: Every nonfinal phase explicitly prohibits it.
Missing local commits or pipeline reconciliation
Each phase ends one local commit; final template includes pipeline comparison and green integration before release.
security: Authorized sources and insufficient-evidence outcomes explicit.
Checks, review and approval retained; settings excluded.
Owned handles/data and refusal under ownership uncertainty explicit.
Draft/implementation authority and numerical run bounds distinguished.
product: Bounded assertion-level cases and held-outs supply one.
Explicit prerequisite, not a product-value defect.
Deliberately excluded and cannot be implied by guidance.
Cited predecessor proof and D03 still required.
scope: Explicit core prerequisite and conservative serial fallback, no incidental predecessor build.
Required audits remain but unrelated edits need scope decision.
Case IDs and calibration bounded; proof-level choice captured separately.
adversarial: Consequence/effective change outranks filename or size.
Requires named predecessor proof and observed D03.
